question: What parts of the body should be permeated by the fluid in this practice?
premises: A fluid is used as the instrument
The action is to color or permeate
The permeation extends to all, beginning with the hair pores
inference: One should permeate everything, beginning with the hair pores, with the fluid.
plain_english: O beloved, one should color everything, beginning with the pores of the hair, with the fluid.
